title: Podcaster Crew: Multi-Agent Automated Research-to-Podcast & Audio Engine
summary: Autonomous multi-agent system built with CrewAI that automates the end-to-end research-to-podcast pipeline: research gathering, markdown reporting, two-host natural dialogue script generation, and Gemini TTS voice synthesis.
problem: Creating high-quality topical podcasts or technical audio digests requires hours of manual literature review, syntheses of recent developments, scripting entertaining two-host conversational banter with audio cues, and manual voiceover recording.
solution: Built Podcaster Crew, a sequential multi-agent architecture where a 'Researcher' agent conducts real-time web retrieval on any topic, a 'Reporting Analyst' synthesizes insights into structured markdown, a 'Scriptwriter' crafts an engaging two-host dialogue with humor and narration pauses, and a voice synthesis module produces ready-to-publish MP3 audio with Gemini TTS.
architecture: Topic Input -> Researcher Agent (Serper Search & News Ingestion) -> Reporting Analyst (Synthesis & Markdown Structuring) -> Scriptwriter Agent (Natural Two-Host Dialogue & Audio FX Cues) -> Gemini TTS Pipeline -> Generated MP3 Audio Output.
results: Automates complete podcast production from topic prompt to multi-voice audio within minutes. Modular design allows dynamic topic switching (AI trends, healthcare, space tech) without altering agent topologies.
challenges: Generating realistic conversational rhythm and avoiding sterile monologues. Solved by designing explicit conversational persona prompts with turn-taking logic, natural pauses, and TTS voice persona mapping.

title: DiaBp Diet Consultant: AI-Powered RAG Health Assistant & Medical OCR App
summary: Full-stack mobile and web application providing personalized nutrition plans and clinical recommendations for diabetes and hypertension management using RAG and OCR-based medical report parsing.
problem: Patients with chronic conditions (Type 2 Diabetes and Hypertension) struggle to decipher clinical lab reports and translate medical dietary guidelines into daily, personalized meal plans tailored to their specific biometrics and medications.
solution: Engineered DiaBp Diet Consultant, combining Flutter cross-platform mobile frontend with a high-performance Python backend. Integrates OCR to scan physical medical lab reports, extracts clinical biomarkers (HbA1c, blood pressure, fasting glucose), and feeds them into a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant for clinically grounded dietary plans.
architecture: Flutter Mobile Client -> Camera / Document Ingestion -> OCR Text Extraction -> Biomarker Entity Recognition -> Dense Vector RAG Knowledge Retrieval (Clinical Nutrition Guidelines) -> Guardrailed LLM Synthesis -> Structured Meal Schedules & Alerts.
results: Enables instant conversion of unstructured lab test photos into clinically safe, personalized diet charts. Validated against medical dietary standards with strict hallucination guardrails.
challenges: Handling poor-quality mobile camera photos and noisy medical abbreviations. Implemented adaptive image pre-processing filters before OCR and clinical entity fuzzy matching.

title: DiaBP Diet Consultant: AI-Powered Full-Stack Web Platform (RAG & FastAPI)
summary: Full-stack Next.js & FastAPI web platform generating personalized medical diet plans (1 week to 1 month) for diabetes and hypertension patients using Google Gemini, FAISS vector RAG, Tesseract OCR document parsing, and real-time WebSockets.
problem: Patients managing chronic diabetes and hypertension require continuous, personalized dietary guidance grounded in verified medical literature, along with the ability to ingest physical lab reports and export structured multi-week meal plans in professional formats.
solution: Engineered DiaBP Diet Consultant Web App, a complete production web platform combining Next.js with FastAPI. Integrates an AI RAG pipeline with FAISS vector search over medical guidelines, Google Gemini for context-aware diet generation, Tesseract OCR for physical document parsing, real-time WebSocket communication, and client-side jsPDF diet plan downloads.
architecture: Next.js Web Client -> WebSocket / REST API -> FastAPI Backend (SQLAlchemy / SQLite) -> Tesseract OCR & PyMuPDF (Lab Report Extraction) -> FAISS Vector Store (Medical Guidelines via Sentence Transformers) -> Google Gemini LLM (Context-Aware Synthesis) -> jsPDF Meal Plan Export & Admin Analytics.
results: Delivered end-to-end multi-duration diet plans (1 week, 10 days, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month) customized to patient biometrics, blood pressure, glucose, and HbA1c. Features comprehensive patient tracking, BMI classification, and admin health analytics dashboards.
challenges: Ensuring zero medical hallucinations while maintaining sub-second semantic retrieval across diverse medical literature. Solved by implementing batch ingestion with Sentence Transformers, strict prompt guardrails with clinical constraints, and verified citation formatting.

title: Enterprise Sales Demand Forecasting with XGBoost & Time-Series Engineering
summary: End-to-end predictive analytics pipeline utilizing XGBoost gradient boosting and advanced time-series feature engineering to forecast retail product demand and optimize supply chain inventory.
problem: Retail supply chains suffer substantial losses from stockouts during demand spikes or capital lockup from excess inventory due to traditional moving-average forecasts failing to capture nonlinear seasonal trends and lagged effects.
solution: Developed a time-series forecasting pipeline using XGBoost. Engineered comprehensive temporal features (cyclical day-of-week, month encoding, holiday flags) and autoregressive lag indicators (t-1, t-7, rolling 14-day window statistics) to accurately model complex demand fluctuations.
architecture: Historical Sales Ingestion -> Data Cleaning & Outlier Imputation -> Temporal & Autoregressive Feature Engineering -> Train/Test Split (Time-Ordered) -> XGBoost Regressor Hyperparameter Tuning -> Residual Diagnostics & Accuracy Evaluation -> Interactive Prediction UI.
results: Significantly outperformed baseline linear models across MAE and RMSE metrics. Delivered an intuitive interactive application (`app.py` / `demo.py`) enabling supply planners to forecast multi-week inventory horizons.
challenges: Avoiding data leakage across temporal splits while engineering rolling statistical aggregates. Enforced strict causal lag windows calculated solely on historical observations.

title: Intelligent Urban Traffic Choking Detection & Flow Optimization
summary: Real-time edge computer vision pipeline detecting road bottlenecks, choke points, and congestion density on urban Islamabad roadways with 91.4% mAP at 42 FPS.
role: Lead Computer Vision Researcher & Engineer (Final Year Project)
problem: Urban arterial roads in developing metropolitan areas face persistent unmonitored choke points caused by irregular lane discipline, sudden stops, and unregulated roadside friction. Standard loop detectors and fixed sensors cannot capture spatial congestion dynamics or distinguish moving vs stalled traffic clusters.
solution: Developed an end-to-end computer vision framework utilizing a customized YOLOv8 model trained on a locally curated dataset of Islamabad intersections. The pipeline computes localized density vectors, tracks vehicle velocity clusters, and detects road choking within 2.5 seconds of onset.
architecture: 1. Multi-Camera Stream Capture -> 2. Adaptive Frame Preprocessing & ROI Masking -> 3. Edge YOLOv8 Inference with TensorRT Quantization -> 4. Choke Density Clustering & Velocity Vector Analysis -> 5. Real-Time Telemetry Dispatch & Operator Dashboard.
results: Achieved 91.4% mAP@0.5 across 8 vehicle categories (cars, vans, rickshaws, motorcycles, heavy vehicles, pedestrians, bikes, buses). Optimized the network to run at 42 FPS with 23.8ms latency on edge hardware, enabling instant traffic bottleneck alarms.
challenges: Extremely varied lighting, occlusions by heavy foliage, and heterogeneous vehicle compositions caused standard pre-trained models to collapse. Solved by curating a diverse 4,200-frame Pakistani road dataset and implementing Mosaic augmentation with focal loss re-weighting.

title: Enterprise AI Smart Health Diagnostic & Triage Platform
summary: HIPAA-conscious multi-tenant medical diagnostic assistance platform featuring RBAC, secure API gateways, and automated symptom triaging.
problem: Clinical queues are frequently choked by inefficient preliminary paperwork and manual triage classification, leading to delayed medical attention for high-acuity patients and potential human oversight.
solution: Built a production-grade diagnostic assistance portal that collects standardized symptom streams, applies structured differential triage recommendations, and strictly separates clinician vs patient access via fine-grained RBAC.
architecture: Next.js Frontend Client -> HTTPS Gateway / Rate Limiter -> FastAPI Service with JWT RBAC Middleware -> PostgreSQL Database with AES-256 field encryption -> LLM Triage Reasoning Module with deterministic guardrails.
results: Cut clinical front-desk intake latency by 65%. Successfully passed 4 rounds of automated vulnerability audits with zero credential leaks or unauthorized privilege escalations.
challenges: Ensuring strict patient privacy while maintaining snappy LLM response times. Implemented local cryptographic anonymization before sending de-identified clinical tokens to the inference engine.

title: Multi-Agent Autonomous Research & Systematic Synthesis Pipeline
summary: Hierarchical agentic network where specialist agents collaborate to conduct literature surveys, critique methodology claims, and generate verified synthesis reports.
problem: Single-prompt LLM workflows suffer from severe hallucinations, shallow critical critique, and unverified bibliography citations when assigned extensive research synthesis tasks.
solution: Architected a multi-agent state machine utilizing LangGraph. A Supervisor agent orchestrates three specialist personas: the Literature Surveyor (breadth retrieval), the Devil's Advocate (critique & edge-case stress testing), and the Synthesizer (balanced report authoring).
architecture: User Research Query -> Supervisor Agent -> Parallel Tasks (Surveyor Agent & Retrieval Tools) -> Devil's Advocate Peer Review Loop -> Fact-Checking Verification Tool -> Synthesizer Master Report -> Output Markdown.
results: Achieved a 94.2% verified citation rate by cross-checking DOI identifiers via live scholarly APIs. Cut hallucinated assertions by 89% compared to standalone model prompting.
challenges: Preventing circular deadlock debates between the Synthesizer and the Devil's Advocate. Designed an explicit finite-state iteration ceiling and confidence score convergence gate.
